name: Zoroastrianism
summary: A tradition originating with Zarathustra and centred on the Avesta, organised at launch into the Parsi and Irani communities.

founded.display: Contested: c. 1500-1000 BCE or 6th century BCE
founded.contested_note: Position 1: linguistic dating of the Gathas places Zoroaster c. 1500-1000 BCE. Position 2: a later tradition dates him to the 6th century BCE. Scholarship is divided

adherents.basis: Community demographic surveys. The 2011 India census counts 57,264 Parsis. Not enumerated by Pew.
